Role: Software Engineer, AI Tooling & Infrastructure
Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA
Level: Mid

Requirements:
- 3+ years software engineering
- Python and/or C++ proficiency
- Experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX)
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Linux systems administration
- Version control (Git) and CI/CD

Preferred:
- GPU programming (CUDA, OpenCL)
- Container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker)
- ML model optimization and deployment
- Edge computing or embedded systems
- Security clearance or eligibility

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain AI/ML development and deployment tooling
- Optimize model training and inference pipelines
- Support internal ML engineers with infrastructure needs
- Maintain security and compliance for classified workloads
